lines.zh: 我被抬着走过一间空房
lines.en: I am carried through an empty room.

lines.zh: 我的双脚不沾地
lines.en: My feet never touch the ground.

lines.zh: 抬我的人换了一次手
lines.en: My carrier changes grip once.

lines.zh: 我经过一面镜子，看见自己
lines.en: I pass a mirror and see myself.

lines.zh: 我的影子从墙上滑过去
lines.en: My shadow slides along the wall.

lines.zh: 我在门框上磕了一下头
lines.en: My head knocks the door frame.

lines.zh: 我被人挪到另一个位置
lines.en: I am shifted to another spot.

lines.zh: 地板上留下两道拖痕
lines.en: Two drag marks remain on the floor.

lines.zh: 我身上的漆掉了一小块
lines.en: A chip of my paint falls away.

lines.zh: 我被举高，又放低
lines.en: I am lifted high, then lowered.

lines.zh: 我经过一扇一直响的窗
lines.en: I pass a window that keeps rattling.

lines.zh: 我终于被放下，正面朝外
lines.en: At last I am set down, facing out.

lines.zh: 我在客厅的角落里站着
lines.en: I stand in a corner of the parlour.

lines.zh: 玻璃罩上落了一层灰
lines.en: A layer of dust covers my glass case.

lines.zh: 我的喙一直是半张的
lines.en: My beak stays half open.

lines.zh: 我的黄色漆面已经发暗
lines.en: My yellow paint has gone dim.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两颗黑玻璃珠
lines.en: My eyes are two black glass beads.

lines.zh: 我不需要看，也不需要听
lines.en: I need neither sight nor hearing.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾固定在一块木板上
lines.en: My toes are fixed to a board.

lines.zh: 白天的光每天从我身上过去
lines.en: Daylight crosses me every day.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛是画上去的
lines.en: My feathers are only painted.

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势，从不累
lines.en: I hold this pose and never tire.

lines.zh: 我的底座上刻着价格
lines.en: A price is carved into my base.

lines.zh: 屋子里的钟走得很慢
lines.en: The clock in this house runs slow.

lines.zh: 我的头永远朝着同一个角度
lines.en: My head holds one angle forever.

lines.zh: 有人擦过我一次，又走了
lines.en: Someone once wiped me down, then left.

lines.zh: 我的底座压着地板一条旧痕
lines.en: My base covers an old mark on the floor.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛上有块褐斑
lines.en: There is a brown blotch on my feathers.

lines.zh: 你在我面前停下脚步
lines.en: You stop in front of me.

lines.zh: 你歪头看我，我歪不了
lines.en: You tilt your head; I cannot.

lines.zh: 我的喙对的方向正好是你
lines.en: My beak points exactly at you.

lines.zh: 你伸手，指尖碰到玻璃
lines.en: You reach out; your fingertip meets glass.

lines.zh: 我喜欢你隔着东西看我
lines.en: I like that you look through something.

lines.zh: 你看我的脚，看得很久
lines.en: You study my feet a long while.

lines.zh: 你想知道我会不会转过来
lines.en: You wonder whether I will turn.

lines.zh: 我的珠子眼睛反出两个你
lines.en: My bead eyes hold two of you.

lines.zh: 你走开两步，又回头
lines.en: You walk two steps off and look back.

lines.zh: 你笑了一下，我不明白
lines.en: You smile once; I do not understand.

lines.zh: 你离我这么近，能闻到灰
lines.en: This close, you can smell the dust.

lines.zh: 我的珠子映出你的肩膀
lines.en: My beads hold your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的手指在玻璃上留下印
lines.en: Your fingers leave prints on the glass.

lines.zh: 我这张脸没有表情可换
lines.en: My face has no expression to change.

lines.zh: 你说了一句话，我听不见
lines.en: You said something; I cannot hear it.

lines.zh: 你把灯举到我面前
lines.en: You hold the lamp up before me.

lines.zh: 我的影子是你挡住的
lines.en: My shadow is one you are blocking.

lines.zh: 你退开，我才恢复原样
lines.en: Step aside and I return to myself.

lines.zh: 我身上的漆掉了一整片
lines.en: A whole patch of paint has come off.

lines.zh: 我的底板裂开一条缝
lines.en: A crack runs through my board.

lines.zh: 我歪着，玻璃罩顶着我
lines.en: I lean against the glass case.

lines.zh: 我的喙缺了一角
lines.en: A corner of my beak is gone.

lines.zh: 灰从我身上抖下来
lines.en: Dust shakes off me.

lines.zh: 我发出的声音像木头断开
lines.en: I sound like wood splitting.

lines.zh: 玻璃罩裂了一道
lines.en: A crack runs through my glass case.

lines.zh: 我的底座被撞得歪了
lines.en: My base has been knocked crooked.

lines.zh: 一根羽毛的漆被刮掉
lines.en: The paint of one feather is scraped off.

lines.zh: 我倒了半边，靠着墙
lines.en: I lean half over against the wall.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着吃的
lines.en: You are holding food.

lines.zh: 我没有喉咙，也没有胃
lines.en: I have no throat and no stomach.

lines.zh: 你把它放在我脚下
lines.en: You set it at my feet.

lines.zh: 我的喙张着，可我不动
lines.en: My beak is open, yet I do not move.

lines.zh: 那东西在我脚边慢慢凉了
lines.en: It cools slowly at my feet.

lines.zh: 我只是一件摆设
lines.en: I am only an ornament.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我尝不到
lines.en: Keep it; I cannot taste.

lines.zh: 你举着手，等得很久
lines.en: You hold it out and wait a long while.

lines.zh: 我脚边已经堆了两样东西
lines.en: Two things already lie at my feet.

lines.zh: 你的好意我收不到
lines.en: I cannot receive your kindness.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的玻璃罩
lines.en: You knock my glass case.

lines.zh: 罩子晃了晃，落下灰
lines.en: The case rocks and dust falls.

lines.zh: 你扶着罩子，怕它碎
lines.en: You steady it, afraid it will break.

lines.zh: 我的木底座在地板上蹭响
lines.en: My wooden base scrapes the floor.

lines.zh: 我的喙顶到你的手臂
lines.en: My beak pokes your arm.

lines.zh: 你退开，掸了掸衣服
lines.en: You step back and brush yourself off.

lines.zh: 你的肘撞在罩子的角上
lines.en: Your elbow meets the corner of my case.

lines.zh: 罩子歪了，我跟着歪
lines.en: The case tilts and I tilt with it.

lines.zh: 你的肩把我撞得滑了半寸
lines.en: Your shoulder slides me half an inch.

lines.zh: 我的底板在你鞋上压了一下
lines.en: My board presses on your shoe.

lines.zh: 我旁边摆着另一个玩偶
lines.en: Another figure stands beside me.

lines.zh: 它比我高，也比我旧
lines.en: It is taller than I am, and older.

lines.zh: 我们被摆在一起卖了
lines.en: We were put together for sale.

lines.zh: 它的玻璃罩上也有灰
lines.en: Dust lies on its case too.

lines.zh: 我们都不说话，都说不了
lines.en: Neither of us speaks, neither can.

lines.zh: 两个影子在墙上挨着
lines.en: Two shadows touch on the wall.

lines.zh: 我们被摆成一排卖
lines.en: We are lined up for sale.

lines.zh: 我的罩子挨着它的罩子
lines.en: My case touches its case.

lines.zh: 它的漆比我的还旧
lines.en: Its paint is older than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起看这间屋子的门
lines.en: We both face this room's door.

lines.zh: 金属的东西掉在我脚边
lines.en: A metal thing falls by my feet.

lines.zh: 我连指头都弯不下来
lines.en: I cannot even bend a finger.

lines.zh: 灰很快盖住了它
lines.en: Dust covers it quickly.

lines.zh: 如果我的手套能动
lines.en: If only my gloves could move.

lines.zh: 我每天看着它，一直没人捡
lines.en: I watch it daily; no one picks it up.

lines.zh: 我记住了它的位置
lines.en: I have memorized its position.

lines.zh: 那东西在灰里只露出一角
lines.en: Only a corner of it shows through the dust.

lines.zh: 我的手一直保持这个姿势
lines.en: My hands hold this pose always.

lines.zh: 要是有人替我弯一下腰
lines.en: If only someone would bend for me.

lines.zh: 日子久了，我连它是什么都忘了
lines.en: In time I forget even what it is.

lines.zh: 我不需要锁定谁
lines.en: I need to lock onto no one.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛朝着前面一格
lines.en: My eyes face one spot ahead.

lines.zh: 你站在那里太久了
lines.en: You have stood there too long.

lines.zh: 我只是被摆成这个样子
lines.en: I am simply arranged this way.

lines.zh: 我没有要盯的人
lines.en: There is no one for me to watch.

lines.zh: 我的喙指着这个方向，不是指你
lines.en: My beak points this way, not at you.

lines.zh: 你站在我的正前方，纯属巧合
lines.en: You stand dead ahead; pure chance.

lines.zh: 我连头都转不了一寸
lines.en: I cannot turn my head an inch.

lines.zh: 你要是害怕，就退开
lines.en: If you are afraid, step aside.

lines.zh: 我这张脸从早到晚都一样
lines.en: My face is the same from dawn to dusk.

lines.zh: 我这副样子是被摆出来的
lines.en: This pose of mine was arranged.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里是一团颜色
lines.en: To me you are only a patch of colour.

lines.zh: 我什么也不会做
lines.en: I will do nothing at all.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里我只算一件家具
lines.en: In this room I count as furniture.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，也不打算开始
lines.en: I do not breathe, and do not intend to.

lines.zh: 你看够了就走开吧
lines.en: Once you have looked enough, move on.

lines.zh: 我没有追过任何东西
lines.en: I have never chased anything.

lines.zh: 我在这面墙前站了很多年
lines.en: I have stood before this wall for years.

lines.zh: 你走动，我的珠子眼不会跟
lines.en: You move; my bead eyes do not follow.

lines.zh: 我只是看着那个方向
lines.en: I am only facing that direction.

lines.zh: 十点血的摆件，AI 都没有。
lines.en: A ten-health ornament with no AI at all.

lines.zh: 屋里的钟敲了两次
lines.en: The clock in the house struck twice.

lines.zh: 我的珠子眼一直朝前
lines.en: My bead eyes face forward always.

lines.zh: 你的影子扫过我的底座
lines.en: Your shadow sweeps across my base.

lines.zh: 我听得见你的脚步，但不动
lines.en: I hear your steps and do not move.

lines.zh: 门开开关关，我都不看
lines.en: Doors open and close; I do not look.

lines.zh: 我从不转身，也转不了
lines.en: I never turn, and cannot.

lines.zh: 灰落在我肩上，一层又一层
lines.en: Dust layers on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 你在我面前来回走
lines.en: You pace back and forth before me.

lines.zh: 我记住的是这个角度
lines.en: This angle is what I remember.

lines.zh: 屋外的光变了，我没变
lines.en: The light outside changes; I do not.

lines.zh: 我一直看着这个方向，雕像不会转头。
lines.en: I stare this way; a statue cannot turn its head.

lines.zh: 你走远了，我还在原处
lines.en: You walk off; I am still here.

lines.zh: 我不需要知道你是谁
lines.en: I do not need to know who you are.

lines.zh: 我根本不会打人
lines.en: I cannot strike anyone at all.

lines.zh: 我的喙只是张着，合不上
lines.en: My beak only hangs open; it will not close.

lines.zh: 撞上我的人，疼的是自己
lines.en: Whoever runs into me hurts only themselves.

lines.zh: 我的手套是空心的
lines.en: My gloves are hollow.

lines.zh: 我的喙顶在你身上，只是木头
lines.en: My beak meets you, and it is only wood.

lines.zh: 我的手套僵着，挥不出去
lines.en: My gloves are frozen; they will not swing.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，木板硌你一下
lines.en: You hit me and the board jabs you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀是漆，不是羽毛
lines.en: My wings are paint, not feathers.

lines.zh: 我连倒下都要人推
lines.en: Even falling needs a push from someone.

lines.zh: 这一下若算打，是木头打的
lines.en: If this counts as a blow, the wood struck it.

lines.zh: 我的底板在撞的时候响了
lines.en: My board rang out on the impact.

lines.zh: 你退开了，我还站着
lines.en: You step away; I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我没有攻击，只有重量
lines.en: I have no attack, only weight.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你手上会留灰
lines.en: Run into me and dust stays on your hands.

lines.zh: 我的喙是这身唯一尖的东西
lines.en: My beak is the only sharp thing on me.

lines.zh: 你小心点，我比看上去沉
lines.en: Be careful; I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 我被抱进屋，放在角落
lines.en: I am carried in and set in the corner.

lines.zh: 包裹的布被揭开
lines.en: The wrapping cloth is pulled away.

lines.zh: 我的漆在灯下泛着旧光
lines.en: My paint shows old light under the lamp.

lines.zh: 有人替我摆正了喙的方向
lines.en: Someone turned my beak straight.

lines.zh: 我对着门，一动不动
lines.en: I face the door, motionless.

lines.zh: 这一晚我就在这儿了
lines.en: Here I will be for the night.

lines.zh: 我被抱进来，放在窗下
lines.en: I am carried in and set beneath the window.

lines.zh: 有人替我把罩子擦了一遍
lines.en: Someone wiped down my case once.

lines.zh: 我的漆在夕阳下像真的羽毛
lines.en: My paint looks like real feathers at sunset.

lines.zh: 我被摆好，正对着门
lines.en: I am set up facing the door.

lines.zh: 包裹的箱子被踢到一边
lines.en: The crate is kicked aside.

lines.zh: 屋里的主人看了我一眼就走了
lines.en: The owner glances at me and leaves.

lines.zh: 我成了这间屋子里最安静的东西
lines.en: I become the quietest thing in this room.

lines.zh: 我的影子第一次落在这块地板上
lines.en: My shadow falls on this floor for the first time.

lines.zh: 门一关，我就被留在原地。
lines.en: The door shuts and leaves me where I am.

lines.zh: 我在这面墙前定住了
lines.en: I settle before this wall.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候我还睁着眼
lines.en: The lamp dies and my eyes stay open.

lines.zh: 我从此不动，也不许谁动我
lines.en: I move no more, and none may move me.

lines.zh: 火先烧着我的羽毛纹
lines.en: Fire takes my painted feathers first.

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下，木头四散
lines.en: I fall off the stand and wood scatters.

lines.zh: 水从玻璃罩的缝里灌进来
lines.en: Water pours through the seam of my case.

lines.zh: 爆风把玻璃罩整个打碎
lines.en: The blast shatters my entire case.

lines.zh: 一颗石子打在我的喙上
lines.en: A pebble strikes my beak.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的木头发响
lines.en: That force makes my wood creak.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，也不会觉得空
lines.en: I need no food, and never feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的珠子照成白色
lines.en: Lightning turns my beads white.

lines.zh: 地板没有了，我连底座一起落
lines.en: The floor is gone; I fall with my base.
